title: Please note that a mask obligation applies at all ETH Library locations.
main_content:
Main article: Please note that a mask obligation applies at all ETH Library locations.

Services: • The Reading Room Collections and Archives and the exhibition of the Max Frisch Archive are regularly open Mon–Fri from 10.00–17.00. For the Reading Room pre-registration is kindly requested.
• The Thomas Mann Archives are accessible by appointment. The exhibition of the Graphische Sammlung can be visited during regular opening hours Mon–Sun from 10.00–16.45.
The regular opening hours apply to all locations. All services and offers can be used as usual.

Events are partly taking place on location again. A mask obligation applies. Please read the notes and details about upcoming events in the events calendar .

Face masks must be worn in all ETH buildings. This also applies to the study spaces. Please bear this in mind when visiting the ETH Library.

E-mail: You can also get in touch with us via WhatsApp or our chat function.

#KnowMore – The prepared content issued by the ETH Library is at your free disposal and gives you a head start.
